title: MPPSC SET 2024 E Certificate
postName: MP SET 2024 – State Eligibility Test E-Certificate
documentsRequired: Application number, roll number, DOB, registered email/mobile
howToApply:
1. Visit https://mppsc.mp.gov.in
2. Open SET / e-Certificate section
3. Login with roll number and DOB
4. Download MP SET e-certificate
5. Print for college recruitment applications
shortDescription: MPPSC SET 2024 E-Certificate – download Madhya Pradesh State Eligibility Test certificate from mppsc.mp.gov.in.
content:
MPPSC conducts the State Eligibility Test (SET) for Assistant Professor eligibility in Madhya Pradesh.

Qualified candidates of SET 2024 can download the e-certificate from the commission portal using exam credentials. Keep a self-attested print for interviews.
